name: DMCC Employment Rules
description: The DMCC Authority’s Employment Rules (Version 3, December 2022), which apply to DMCC licensees on top of the UAE Labour Law: costs and passports, the written limited-term contract, insurance, termination formalities and visa cancellation. Use with the federal labour rulesets. DRAFT: not yet legally reviewed.

clauses.title: Introduction to UAE Labour Law: no contracting out of the UAE Labour Law
clauses.content: It is open to Licensees to enhance the statutory minimum position under the UAE Labour Law and DMCCA encourages its members to do so. It is not however possible to contract out of the UAE Labour Law (i.e. to agree with employees that certain aspects of the UAE Labour Law, such as end of service gratuity for example, do not apply).
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: General: approval to work outside the free zone
clauses.content: An employee of a Licensee may not work outside the DMCC Free Zone without first obtaining prior written approval from the Licensee.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: General: charges and sanctions not recoverable from employees
clauses.content: The charges and Sanctions referred to in Rules 3.4 and 3.5 are the sole responsibility of the Licensee and may not be recovered from employees under any circumstances.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Recruitment: recruitment costs borne by the licensee
clauses.content: All costs of recruitment and other employment related services (including, but not limited to, the costs of obtaining a UAE residency visa and Employment Approval or Access Approval) must be born solely by the Licensee.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Recruitment: no recharging of recruitment costs
clauses.content: Under no circumstances may a Licensee, recruitment agent, subcontractor or other third party working directly or indirectly on behalf of the Licensee, recharge or pass all or any part of such costs to a recruited employee.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Employee Passports: no holding passports without consent
clauses.content: No Licensee may hold the passport of an employee without the employee’s prior written and genuine consent.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Employee Passports: safekeeping and return of passports
clauses.content: Where an employee has consented in writing to a Licensee holding his or her passport, the Licensee must have effective procedures and controls in place to ensure that retained passports are held in a safe and secure facility and can and will be returned to the employee promptly at the employee’s request.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Contract of Employment: written contract
clauses.content: A Licensee must have a written contract of employment with each employee. The terms and conditions of such contract of employment are a matter of negotiation between the Licensee and the employee.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Contract of Employment: at least the UAE Labour Law; less favourable terms void
clauses.content: The contract of employment must, as a minimum, comply with the provisions of the UAE Labour Law. Any term in the contract of employment which is less favourable to an employee than the statutory minimum position under the UAE Labour Law shall be void and unenforceable.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Contract of Employment: limited duration
clauses.content: The contract of employment must be for a limited duration, subject to renewal, as agreed by the employee and employer.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Insurance: medical insurance
clauses.content: All Licensees must procure and maintain a medical insurance policy for all of its employees in accordance with applicable law. Evidence of a valid medical insurance policy must be provided to DMCCA upon request.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Insurance: employer’s liability insurance
clauses.content: All Licensees must procure and maintain employer's liability insurance (covering workmen’s compensation and workplace health and safety insurance), as required by DMCCA and for such minimum level of cover as DMCCA may require from time to time. Evidence of valid employer's liability insurance must be provided to DMCCA upon request.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Insurance: insurance costs borne by the licensee
clauses.content: The costs of such medical insurance and workmen’s compensation and workplace health and safety insurance must be borne solely by the Licensee and must not be passed to employees whether directly or indirectly.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Employee Accommodation: accommodation standards
clauses.content: Where Licensees provide accommodation to employees, such accommodation must comply with applicable statutory minimum requirements in relation to standards of accommodation (in relation to lighting, ventilation, size, sanitation etc.).
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Harassment in the Workplace: harassment and bullying
clauses.content: DMCCA expects all Licensees to share its commitment to providing a working environment free from harassment and bullying and ensuring that all employees are treated, and treat others, with dignity and respect.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Termination of Employment: notice after probation
clauses.content: Following the probationary period, both the employer and employee may terminate the limited term employment contract before the expiry of the contract for a legitimate reason by giving not less than thirty (30) Days' advance written notice of termination or any greater period (subject to a maximum of ninety (90) Days) provided for in the contract of employment.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Termination of Employment: notice during probation
clauses.content: During the probationary period, both the employee and employer can terminate the employment contract by serving at least fourteen (14) Days written notice of termination prior to the expiry of the probationary period. However, where the employee is serving notice during the probationary period in order to join another employer in the UAE, the employee must serve at least thirty (30) Days’ notice.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Termination of Employment: dismissal without notice
clauses.content: A Licensee may terminate an employee's employment immediately (without any obligation to provide notice or payment in lieu of notice) if any one of the exhaustive list of circumstances set out under Article 44 of the UAE Labour Law is applicable
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Termination of Employment: signed confirmation on termination
clauses.content:
Where an employee’s contract of employment terminates for any reason whatsoever, both the Licensee and the employee must deliver a signed letter of confirmation, in such format as may be specified by DMCCA from time to time, confirming that:
a) the employment has come to an end; and
b) that the Licensee has paid and the employee has received all sums due and owing to the employee (including, without limitation, any applicable end-of-service gratuity payment).
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Termination of Employment: payment within fourteen days
clauses.content: All payments due to the employee on termination of employment should be paid to the employee within fourteen (14) Days of the termination/expiration of the contract.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Termination of Employment: repatriation flight
clauses.content:
On termination of employment, Licensees will be required to provide the employee with a repatriation flight back to his/her home country unless:
a) the employee obtains new sponsorship in the UAE within 30 Days of the cancellation of his/her residency visa; or
b) the reason for the termination is attributable to the employee (unless the employee does not have the means to purchase the flight, in which case the obligation falls back to the Licensee), and must not seek to recover such costs from the employee.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Visa cancellation: cooperation on visa cancellation
clauses.content: The Licensee and the employee must cooperate to arrange the cancellation of the employee's residency visa following the termination of the employee's employment.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)

clauses.title: Visa cancellation: visa cancellation fees borne by the licensee
clauses.content: The Licensee shall be solely responsible for bearing any fees incurred in relation to the cancellation of the employee's residency visa, Employment Approval or Access Approval (in accordance with the Schedule of Charges) and is prohibited from recovering such costs from the employee.
clauses.source_title: DMCC Employment Rules, Version 3 (DMCC Authority, updated 12 December 2022)
